subject: alt-f
title: ALT.F.------DEC.
description: Diagram in CMBA-20, the third on book p264. ALT-F (alternative functionalism) is crossed with DEC (decentralization). ALT-F outputs to DEC (the crossing) and TH-CONT (thrust continuance). TH-CONT → EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics) → (C)INFO-DE (the concept of information degrees). INFO-DE branches to MT-IF-DB (multi-informational degree basis) and POL-SIGN (political significance) → PROG-EXT-FT (progressional extended functionalism). Structural argument: alternative functionalism's productive output runs alternative-functionalism → thrust-continuance → expansion-dynamics → (concept of) information-degrees → political-significance → progressional-extended-functionalism — a six-stage chain where each step is gated by the previous. The (c) on information-degrees is critical: this is the *concept* of information degrees, not their reality, which is what allows the alternative to remain alternative. The branch from information-degrees to multi-informational-degree-basis runs in parallel.
